generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
from: We couldn't find the starting point. Pick one from the suggestions.
to: We couldn't find the destination. Pick one from the suggestions.
same: Start and destination are the same place.
noTrips: No trips found for this time. Try a different time or date.
quoteExpired: This price has expired. We fetched a fresh price — please confirm again.
userRejected: You cancelled the request in your wallet. Nothing was charged.

chain.InvalidSignature: The price could not be verified. Refresh the page and try again.
chain.QuoteExpired: The price expired (10 min limit). Tap the button again for a fresh price.
chain.QuoteAlreadyUsed: This booking was already made. Check “My trips”.
chain.NotPassenger: Use the same wallet you requested the price with.
chain.OperatorInactive: This operator is not taking bookings right now.
chain.OperatorNotRegistered: This operator is not registered for bookings.
chain.NotLegOperator: Only the operator of this service can do this. Connect the operator wallet.
chain.NotTicketHolder: Only the ticket holder can do this.
chain.InvalidStatus: This ticket was already used, cancelled or refunded.
chain.RefundDeadlinePassed: The free-cancellation window has passed for this ticket.
chain.NoShowTooEarly: No-show can be claimed only 2 hours after departure.
chain.BadQuote: The booking details are invalid. Search again.
chain.TicketLocked: Tickets can't be transferred after check-in or cancellation.
chain.FaucetCooldown: You already received test money this hour. Try again later.
chain.ERC20InsufficientBalance: Not enough test money. Tap “Get free test money”.
chain.ERC20InsufficientAllowance: Payment wasn't confirmed. Tap the button again.
chain.ERC721InsufficientApproval: You are not allowed to move this ticket.
chain.InsufficientGas: Your wallet needs a little AVAX for network fees. Get test AVAX from the Fuji faucet.
chain.WrongNetwork: Your wallet is on another network. Tap “Switch to Avalanche”.
